LIKELIHOOD: 30

That is a very uncertain subjective estimate, not a statistical finding. An all-male panel raises a reasonable question about diversity and safeguards against bias, but does not establish that sex influenced this decision.

Your longer experience and project leadership warrant substantive feedback. However, client relationships, business development and people management could legitimately outweigh years of design experience for this role. The announcement may omit relevant qualifications.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and how your application was assessed. You can also ask how the panel ensured a fair, unbiased process—without alleging discrimination. Inconsistent explanations or evidence of unequal treatment would strengthen grounds for escalation.
